name: Skisafari Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Explore the entire **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis** ski resort in a single day! An experienced ski guide will take you to the best downhill runs, hidden powder slopes, and sunniest terraces. The tour concludes with a post-ski drink at the **Schirmbar**—the legendary gathering spot at 2,000 meters.
